claims: No. 1 seed UCLA defeated No. 3 seed Duke 70-58 in the 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight on March 29, 2026
UCLA advanced to the Final Four
The 20-8 third-quarter surge was led by Lauren Betts
The game was at Golden 1 Center, Sacramento, CA
UCLA outscored Duke 54-28 in the paint
Duke forced 12 UCLA turnovers in the first half
UCLA mounted a 16-5 run in the third quarter
This victory secured UCLA's second consecutive Final Four appearance
The game was a rematch of an earlier season game
UCLA won the earlier season game
The win moved UCLA to a 2-2 all-time record against Duke in women's basketball
